thread:
maria: heads-up — nightly eval flagged a regression after the prompt-bundle bump (bundle-v8 -> bundle-v8.1). overall Answer-F1 down ~4.3% on the confirmation tests

samir: which test groups? can you paste the alert?

maria: eval-bot posted this in #ci-alerts but copying the relevant lines:
```
ALERT: nightly-eval
model: rwd-open-a-1
suite: confirmation-family
baseline (bundle-v8): Answer-F1 0.882
current (bundle-v8.1): Answer-F1 0.845
delta: -0.037 (-4.2%)
```
link: https://github.internal/redwood/evals/runner/20398 (PR: https://github.internal/redwood/promptbank/pulls/452)

eli: did the prompt bundle include any normalization/token changes? tokenization drift explains small but systematic F1 drops

maria: there was a small wording tweak in the instruction layer — replaced "Confirm if" -> "Let me know if" in ~30 prompts. no tokenizer config was changed in the PR. diff snippet:
```
- Q: "Confirm if the user wants to keep the default."
+ Q: "Let me know if the user wants to keep the default."
```
(see PR comment for full diff)

ciara: hmm wording changes often affect the mimic tasks. can you paste 3 failing generations (baseline vs current)?

maria: sure — example 1:
BASELINE: "Yes — I'll keep the default."
CURRENT:  "I'm not sure, please confirm."  <-- different intent mapping, scored wrong label

example 2:
BASELINE: "No, please change it."
CURRENT:  "I think we should keep the default."  <-- flips answer

samir: that's concerning. those look like meaning-preserving rewrites gone wrong. Did QA run the local rerun with the same seed?

maria: ran a quick local batch against model rwd-open-a-1 (cpu debug) with --seed 42, reproduced ~80% of failures on the small subset. command I used: `python eval_runner.py --suite confirmation-family --prompts promptbank/bundle-v8.1 --model rwd-open-a-1 --seed 42`

eli: ok. next question: do we intend the wording change? If yes — we should rebaseline the gold labels. If no — revert the prompt edits.

ciara: do we have product sign-off on wording? @maria did you coordinate with UX?

maria: UX asked for the "Let me know" phrasing for clarity in several microflows. Product approved in the PR description but didn't run full eval.

samir: then it's an intended change. proposal: create a rebaseline PR (gold updates) and run full nightly-eval pre-merge. keep the prompt edits but update labels where behavior legitimately changed. conservative approach: revert only the prompts that flip high-confidence labels and rebaseline the rest.

ciara: +1 to conservative. also add a changelog entry and run quantized-model smoke to ensure quantization doesn't amplify the drift. tagging @eli to run quantized run (int8) on the same suite.

eli: on it — I'll kick off an int8 run and post results in this thread.

eval-bot: scheduled job queued: nightly-eval (full) for bundle-v8.1 against rwd-open-a-1 and rwd-open-a-1-int8. run id: 20476

maria: thanks. I'll open the rebaseline PR with a list of suggested gold updates + a revert candidate list. requesting approvals: @ciara @samir for rollback vs rebaseline decision.

ciara: approved for rebaseline, please include a short note explaining UX intent and attach failing example pairs to the PR. :thumbsup:

samir: approved assuming we run the full eval and quantized checks before merging. add an eval-run checklist to the PR template.

maria: will do. thanks team — I'll link back here once PR is up and when the int8 run finishes.
